items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Walter Pichon alto. ... [INTERVIEWER] You told me once he played alto on the one. Yeah, that's right. The piano player.

ctx.x: I think the Onward. We leave out a man. Pardon me. We leave out a man. Who was that?
Oh, yeah. I forgot. You told me.
